newsitem.title: GERMANY: German pay TV group picks new manager.
newsitem.headline: German pay TV group picks new manager.

text.p: German pay TV group Premiere on Thursday said Ferdinand Kayser, a board member of the European broadcasting group CLT/Ufa, has been appointed as its new managing director.
Kayser replaces Bernd Kundrun, who stepped down to run the newspaper division of Germany biggest magazine publisher Gruner+Jahr, which is owned by Bertelsmann AG.
Premiere is currently owned by Bertelsmann, French pay TV group Canal Plus and Bavarian media tycoon Leo Kirch.
Canal Plus intends to sell its shares to Kirch and Bertelsmann and Kirch have a basic agreement to jointly own Premiere.
Premiere has 1.5 million subscribers and is planning to launch digital TV services later this year.
